description: The edge answers a 413 with its own HTML page, not the JSON envelope. The error is classified by its status alone (RequestTooLargeError); error_type is empty, and the message is the client's own description, "HTTP 413 Content Too Large", from the fixed status-text table, never the HTTP library's wording. The page is never read into any field. There is no x-request-id, so no request id.
